create_DoclingJSONBackend: create a DoclingJSONBackend instance from a JSON file path or BytesIO stream containing Docling JSON
test_is_valid: test whether a DoclingJSONBackend instance is valid by checking if it successfully parsed a DoclingDocument
run_convert: run the convert method on a DoclingJSONBackend to retrieve the parsed DoclingDocument or raise a parsing exception
review_supported_formats: review the supported_formats class method to confirm it returns InputFormat.JSON_DOCLING
review_supports_pagination: review the supports_pagination class method which returns False indicating no pagination support
